items.problem: The change order and the timed item rules assume the saved balance is at most the balance limit (item-ledger.md:93), but `## data` of item-ledger does not forbid lowering `max_amount` of an item that users already hold, and `prod_change` only blocks values that a core spec `## data` says cannot change (skills/data/SKILL.md:353). After `max_amount` is lowered below a saved balance B, an `add_items` of 1 to a `Discard` item gives a balance more than `max_amount`, so step 3 "sets the balance to `max_amount`", which lowers the balance on an add with a negative `delta`, and the `overflow` value is not set for this case. For a timed item with `Discard`, k = ⌊(`max_amount` × `duration` − R) ÷ `duration`⌋ (item-ledger.md:150) is negative when R > `max_amount` × `duration`, so E moves earlier on an add. The spec sets this case for `recovery_cap` (item-ledger.md:362) but not for `max_amount`, so implementations can differ
